description: Fail over the primary node of each ElastiCache (Redis OSS) replication group that carries the given tag, using the TestFailover API, and wait until the failover completes and the former primary has recovered as a replica.

AutomationAssumeRole.description: ARN of the IAM role that Systems Manager Automation assumes to run this document

tagKey.description: Tag key to identify ElastiCache replication groups to target

tagValue.description: Tag value to identify ElastiCache replication groups to target
